title: Neotec 3 White

specs.eps_liner_structure: Multi-Density Segmented EPS Matrix with Integrated Cooling Channels

description: The Shoei Neotec 3 White combines flip-up modular convenience with highway touring comfort, delivering flip-up versatility for city stops and sealed protection at speed. Built around a Advanced Multi-Composite (Carbon-Aramid-Glass / AIM+) shell weighing 1607g, its multi-density EPS matrix is aerodynamically sculpted to isolate cabin noise to ~86 dB while dissipating kinetic impact forces across DOT, ECE 22.06 benchmarks. Inside, 3D laser-cut cheek pads tailor naturally to an Intermediate Oval profile with dedicated eyewear relief channels, secured by track-proven Double D-Ring retention for confident all-day riding.

product_details.description: Shoei Neotec 3 offers premium modular convenience with ECE 22.06 safety.

sizing_fit.fit_notes: Designed for intermediate oval head shapes; may feel tight on round heads or loose on long oval heads.

technical_analysis: Features Advanced Integrated Matrix Plus (AIM+) 6-layer organic fiber and fiberglass composite shell paired with CWR-F2 3D injection-molded visor with Pinlock EVO lens inserts and vortex generators along the shield edges. The interior utilizes Dual-layer multi-density EPS with internal cooling channels and 3D Max-Dry custom cheek pad fitment with pre-shaped speaker cutouts for seamless Bluetooth comms integration.
marketing_description: Experience the Shoei Neotec 3 White: combining Japan 🇯🇵 craftsmanship with CWR-F2 3D injection-molded visor with Pinlock EVO lens inserts and vortex generators along the shield edges and Dual-layer multi-density EPS with internal cooling channels and 3D Max-Dry custom cheek pad fitment. Perfect for riders who demand uncompromised safety and aero-acoustic comfort.
yoast_title: Shoei Neotec 3 White: Specs, Real-World Review & Price Guide
yoast_metadesc: In-depth review of the Shoei Neotec 3 White. Tested shell weight, ECE/DOT safety rating, noise dB quietness, and fitment guide for Intermediate Oval heads.

qualitative_intelligence.visor_optical_clarity: Class 1 Distortion-Free Optically Correct shield with Pinlock 120 MaxVision anti-fog lens insert included.

introduction: Positioned in Shoei's Modular lineup, the Neotec 3 White brings Japanese engineering to riders seeking balance between weight, cabin acoustics, and impact protection. Designed for an Intermediate Oval fitment, it connects daily usability with certified DOT, ECE 22.06 track safety.
story:
The Shoei Neotec 3 White represents Shoei's dedicated protective engineering, incorporating aerodynamic shell sculpting and multi-density EPS impact damping. Its Advanced Multi-Composite (Carbon-Aramid-Glass / AIM+) shell dampens high-speed wind resonance while multi-density EPS channels absorb kinetic energy across direct and oblique impact vectors.

On the road, intake ports channel air across the scalp, keeping cabin noise around ~86 dB at 100 km/h. For riders seeking an Advanced Multi-Composite (Carbon-Aramid-Glass / AIM+) Modular helmet tailored to an Intermediate Oval head shape, the Shoei Neotec 3 White delivers verified safety and long-distance rider comfort.
